main_text.l: ἐνδείξει τῷ ἔντος[?] significatione modi: cùm sci
micos, sed sine contumelia, conuitiis, ca-
lumniis. Et hæc in reprehendendo tũ sunt
eos vituperare necesse habemus, quos ali-
qua ex parte metuimus, aut hactenus be-
vel sceleratos atq; improbos simplex vsur
pari reprehensio potest. Ad motus verò
quod attinet, in vituperando animi eò sunt
ac tractatio ita instituitur: vt prima pars
tur: aut ἀφορμὴ[?] adhortatione. lib.7. epist.

page.notes: Gathering signature "n 5" at the foot. The first Greek word and the Greek words in the margin notes and at "aut ... adhortatione" are read with doubt and marked [?]. The margin note "ψυχικὰ[?] mo-ventes" is partly illegible and was read only with doubt. No catchword is visible. Printing errors are left as they are: "sententiæ" in the first line and "aut" before the Greek word. The printed lines read "potifsimum", "fimplex" and similar forms, which were copied as printed where legible.
